summary: Lunar Base: Mission Trainer is an educational browser-based simulation that demonstrates the challenges of maintaining a sustainable human outpost on the Moon. Players must manage essential resources such as power, oxygen, food, and radiation protection while keeping the crew safe for a 10-day mission. The simulation allows users to adjust resource priorities, advance mission days, monitor resource levels, and observe mission logs. It provides a simple and interactive way to understand the importance of resource management and decision-making in future lunar exploration.
details:
Lunar Base: Mission Trainer is a web-based educational simulation designed to demonstrate the challenges of managing a lunar outpost.

The project simulates a 10-day lunar mission where users must maintain four essential resources: power, oxygen, food, and radiation protection.

Users can adjust daily resource priorities using interactive sliders for life support, radiation protection, and food production. Each adjustment affects resource consumption and the sustainability of the lunar base. Players can advance the mission one day at a time, restart the mission, and monitor progress through a mission log.

The main objective is to keep all essential resources above zero throughout the 10-day mission.

This project is an educational prototype. Its values and random events are illustrative game mechanics and are not actual NASA engineering data or operational guidance.
